description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum, which is responsible for validating attribute values against a list of enumerated (allowed) values within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing such enumerations, validating input strings, and creating new enumeration instances from string definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum
classes.description: A class for defining and validating enumerated attribute values, with case sensitivity options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enumeration with a list of valid values and case sensitivity setting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given string against the enumeration of valid values, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum instance from a comma-separated string, with optional case sensitivity.
